tasks.body:
Goal:
- Freeze and commit the completed dirty source and evidence before integrating diverged branches.

Touch:
- Current tracked/untracked completed work, Git source inventory, canonical workflow registry and integration evidence.

Implementation constraints:
- Preserve canonical task identities, stopped checkpoints, original receipts, secrets and per-account consent. No force push, destructive reset, automatic history rewrite, live gameplay test, independent-user acceptance or backlog implementation.
- Inspect the complete candidate file list, excluded ignored secrets and exact source hashes. Preserve the previous controller before explicit registry adoption. The owner authorizes the scoped snapshot commit; no remote branch is updated during preservation.
